contentText: On this edition of Entre Nous we take a deep dive into French football fashion. For many, ‘les bleus’ are already the champions of a de facto sartorial competition, particularly on the Clairefontaine ‘catwalk’, or when the players head to their training ground. We also discuss the rich history and many rules regarding their FFF, Nike, Jacquemus kits, as fans and collectors are already lining up for the shirts.
